reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`doublewrite_identity_kvstore_only_count` has been renamed to `doublewrite_kvstore_only_identities`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Monitoring systems and dashboards that reference the old metric name doublewrite_identity_kvstore_only_count will no longer receive data; they must be updated to use the new name doublewrite_kvstore_only_identities.

proposed.statement: The metric doublewrite_identity_kvstore_only_count has been renamed to doublewrite_kvstore_only_identities.
